Original freeze 0083d281ec8b4a089504519de450a03f415aa219 and the failed R4-A2 overfit logs (experiments/R4A/r4a2/M*_overfit_log.json, commit 599cf74cd783cba3ecbecf41d36bc02068bdf1c4) are kept unchanged.
base_freeze: experiments/R4A/r4a2/freeze_config.json @ 0083d281ec8b4a089504519de450a03f415aa219 (sha256 f30207831b2580078fa979c8f595c382fca892e3ace3ebfda1cfa9a723eeaf08); every key not listed under 'changes' is inherited unchanged

changes.v1: soft exp(-d^2/2) for d<=2 px (weight 1); 2<d<=8 px IGNORE_TRAIN (weight 0); d>8 px negative (weight 1)
changes.v2: soft exp(-d^2/2) for d<=2 px (weight 1, unchanged); 2<d<=4 px negative with weight 0.1; 4<d<=8 px negative with weight 0.3; d>8 px negative (weight 1); IGNORE_EVAL weight 0
changes.why: P0: 72-73% of the 1 px failures were in the unsupervised 2-8 px band, where the output (median p ~0.45) was unconstrained

changes.v2: L1 weighted by the same v2 per-pixel weight

changes.v1: markers = CC of (dist_pred_px >= 3) with area >= 50 px
changes.v2: hybrid markers (see postprocess_v2.M2); v1 rule is still run and reported as the A/B baseline

supervision.distance_source: official dist.npy (DIST_L2 mask 3), same as the frozen labels
supervision.weight_rationale: Chosen once from P0 and the registration evidence, not searched. A positive weight of any size makes the pointwise optimum in 2-8 px equal 0, which removes the unconstrained band (P0 cause 1). The weights are kept low because the GeoTIFF check measured a residual offset of 1-2 px (grid residual max 2.26 px, docs/research/r4a/geotiff_check.md): printed ink can sit 2-4 px from the vector boundary, so that band gets the lowest weight (0.1); 4-8 px is beyond every measured residual, so it gets more (0.3) but still below 1 to keep part of the uncertainty allowance the approved v1 rule intended. Effect of the 4-8 px weight on output width is reported (band width and per-zone probability) in P5.
supervision.evaluation_truth: unit_boundary.npy, 1 px rule, NOT moved or widened (actual width 2.03 px: both sides of each unit transition)

overfit_gate.threshold_rationale: p* = 4t/(3t+1) is the loss optimum; 0.8 = p*(t = 0.5), i.e. the soft target's half maximum mapped through pos_weight 4. p* > 0.8 iff d < 1.18 px, so axial neighbours (d = 0.955) are in and diagonal / 2 px pixels are out, matching the 1 px tolerance. Theoretical optimum on this tile at 0.8: F1@1/2/3 = 0.9997/0.9998/0.9999, band 4.04, centreline 0.18 px (at 0.5 it was 0.904). Derived from the loss. Disclosure: chosen after the P0 outputs at thresholds 0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9 had been seen. Re-scoring the v1 P0 probability maps at 0.8 gives F1@1 0.982 (M1) / 0.995 (M2), so F1 alone would already pass at 0.8; the gate is made binding by the added criteria (fit to the v2 target, where the v1 maps score 0.141 / 0.131 against a 0.05 limit, band width and centreline), which the v1 models fail.

criteria_all_required.fit_mae_note: mean |p - p*| on weight>0 pixels (target fit, P2 item 1)
criteria_all_required.centreline_note: skeleton(p>0.8) vs skeleton(UNIT_BOUNDARY), both directions (P2 item 2)
criteria_all_required.F1_note: p>0.8 vs raw UNIT_BOUNDARY, all pixels incl. the former IGNORE_TRAIN band; no pixel is excluded from F1 except IGNORE_EVAL (P2 item 3)
criteria_all_required.band_note: predicted px per truth-skeleton px; optimum 4.04 at thr 0.8, limit = 1.25x optimum (P2 item 4)
criteria_all_required.degradation_note: final F1@1 >= peak F1@1 over checkpoints - 0.05, and final loss <= loss at the middle checkpoint (P2 item 5)
criteria_all_required.m2_note: M2 only: mean |dist_pred - dist| in px on weight>0 pixels

also_reported_not_gated: v1 P0 probability maps re-scored under the v2 gate for reference ONLY (not a pass)
overfit_gate.on_failure: stop; no formal training; no further trial runs

postprocess_v2.M1: unchanged (watershed on probability, markers = CC of p<0.3 with area >= 50 px)
postprocess_v2.M2: hybrid_markers: v1 markers (dist>=3 px, area>=50 px) + every h-maxima component of log1p(GaussianBlur(dist, 1 px)) with h = log 2 and dist >= 0.9 px that touches no v1 marker; watershed on -dist_pred
postprocess_v2.M2_baseline_ab: v1 rule, run on the same predictions and reported side by side
postprocess_v2.selection_history: pure h-maxima (new_markers) tried first on 05016 then all 10 training sheets: small recall 0.949 but large-instance recall 0.772; hybrid v1 (add only maxima with peak < 3 px) missed area-threshold failures; hybrid v2 adopted. Selected on the 10 TRAINING sheets with the official distance map only; validation sheets 15023/15041 not used for the choice (their seed diagnosis is run after this commit and reported only).
postprocess_v2.known_limit: with the frozen parameters (smooth 1 px, ratio 2, min dist 0.9 px) a straight strip is seeded only from 7 px width; 3-6 px strips get no new seed (unit test test_documented_width_limit). On the 10 training sheets 2.6% of small instances stay unseeded with the official distance map. Found before this freeze; parameters not changed.
postprocess_v2.seed_input_rule: prediction-time markers use dist_pred only; geo_A is never read for seeds

official_dist_ceiling_train.note: capability ceiling with the OFFICIAL distance map; not a model result

evaluation: unchanged from v1 metrics (primary: small-instance class-agnostic IoU>=0.5 recall per validation sheet; decision rule unchanged); M2 reported with both seed rules
